updates.title: Title Update v1.1.0
updates.summary: Title Update v1.1.0 is quality-of-life, small mode fixes, and tighter competitive security. It does not retune gameplay balance or physics. PC builds push stricter platform checks so online matches stay on an even field. Read this note before you launch. It is not an undetected claim.

updates.title: Ultimate Team
updates.summary: High-OVR pack opening reveals are shorter. Squad Building Challenge filter choices now stay saved across sessions.

updates.title: Career Mode
updates.summary: Team Management UI is rebuilt. New toggles cover press conferences and unexpected events. Transfer and contract rejections show clearer feedback.

updates.title: The Grounds / Clubs
updates.summary: Fixes overlapping UI at full time. Fixes a bug that let a side field two active goalkeepers at once.

updates.title: EA Javelin and third-party tools
updates.summary: PC builds keep kernel-level EA Javelin on and scan for unauthorized background apps. The patch targets forbidden external tools: auto-SBC clients, Ped modding frameworks, match-manipulation injectors, and win-sharing clients. Blacklisted software at launch can force a security-violation kick or a crash to desktop. Confirm this page still matches your installed build before you open the loader.

updates.title: “Updated” is not an undetected claim
